t: Regulate is only available on Stocker Mode.$(br2)Regulate ensures the counting filter will keep the specified amount of resources in the inventory, no more no less.
固定数量仅在存储模式可用。$(br2)固定数量确保计数过滤器会在对应存储空间内存有给定数量的物品、流体或能量，不多也不少。

When Regulate mode is disabled, excess items will not be removed. If a stocker is requesting 32 cobblestone with a Counting Filter, and a player or another card adds more cobblestone, the excess cobblestone will not be removed.$(br2)With Regulate mode enabled, the excess cobble would be removed, if there is an inserter that can accept it.
禁用固定数量时，多余物品不会被取出。若某存储卡以计数过滤器请求 32 个圆石，当玩家或物流卡存入更多圆石时，这些多出来的圆石不会被取出。$(br2)启用固定数量，且在网络内有输入卡能接收圆石时，多余的圆石会被取出。
